name: North/Middle Yuba prospecting pins (verified)
description: Pins for Blue Lead conglomerate exposures (Task 1) and unworked North/Middle Yuba reaches (Task 2). All coordinates re-verified against USGS GNIS/MRDS/NWIS, USGS 3DEP elevation, ESRI/OSM imagery and named-feature cross-references. Coordinates are WGS84/NAD83 decimal degrees. See accompanying markdown table for source citations, confidence ratings, and access notes.

properties.site: Brandy City pit NW headwall
properties.what_visible: Bright bare-earth pit wall on the N-NW margin of central pit pond; 50-60 ft vertical relief in 1m DEM
properties.access: Hwy 49 at Camptonville -> Old Mountain House / Indian Springs / Brandy City Rd (~10 mi, dirt last mi). Walk rim trail clockwise from pond.

properties.site: Cherokee Creek incision through La Porte channel projection
properties.what_visible: Forested creek thalweg, no road; topographic low on OSM Cherokee Creek polyline
properties.access: From Brandy City pond, hike S/SE ~0.4 mi (~400 ft drop) to creek bed.

properties.site: Poker Flat townsite / Canyon Creek incision
properties.what_visible: Mining tailings, old foundations, OHV trail; Canyon Creek bed at ~4,750-4,780 ft
properties.access: 4WD only via Howland Flat Rd / Poker Flat Rd from La Porte. USFS campground at townsite.

properties.site: Howland Flat NW switchback on Poker Flat Rd
properties.what_visible: Road switchback through upper gravels; townsite hydraulic scars visible ~500m SSW
properties.access: Poker Flat Rd from La Porte (Plumas Co.) via Port Wine Ridge.
properties.note: User has visited Howland Flat and confirmed sloughed walls - listed for completeness only; not a strong candidate.

properties.site: Gardner's Point Mine / Grass Flat hydraulic pit
properties.what_visible: Textbook hydraulic-mine signature on satellite: barren red/orange pit walls, ponded water in pit floor, exposed Tertiary gravel benches
properties.access: Port Wine Ridge Rd; private property with caretaker (Brush Creek Mining & Dev, last production 1989) - access requires permission.

properties.site: Eureka Diggings hydraulic pit (broad pit area)
properties.what_visible: Documented hydraulic-mine pit polygon (Yeend 1974/USGS); pit complex extends >1 km
properties.access: From Downieville take Saddleback Rd NW ~5 mi, then spur road. Tahoe NF.
properties.note: No contemporary trip report verifying current wall condition; ranking is based on Lindgren reserve estimate (30M yd^3) implying large standing walls.

properties.site: Ruby Mine drift portal (active operation)
properties.what_visible: Active mine infrastructure, headframe, road (per rubymine.com)
properties.access: Sec 15 NW T19N R10E, north of Alleghany. PRIVATE - requires owner permission (contact via Underground Gold Miners Museum, Alleghany).
properties.note: Highest-probability site for fresh in-mine blue lead exposure in the region.

properties.site: Bald Mountain Extension drift mine portal
properties.what_visible: Adit only - limited surface signature; near Ruby Mine on same Tertiary channel
properties.access: Sec 15/21/22 T19N R10E, 1.5 mi NNE of Forest City.
properties.note: MRDS positional accuracy ~5km; treat as approximate.

properties.site: N Fork Oregon Creek crossing Bald Mountain Tertiary channel axis
properties.what_visible: Creek incision into bedrock; thalweg exposure possible after winter flow
properties.access: Approach via Forest City; faint user trails down N Fork Oregon Cr drainage.
properties.note: Channel-axis crossing location is interpolated, not field-verified.

properties.site: Moores Flat hydraulic pit center
properties.what_visible: Large hydraulic pit visible on satellite; documented Yeend 1974 fig 9 lower-gravel exposure on NW edge
properties.access: Bowman Lake Rd / Graniteville area; Nevada Co.
properties.county: Nevada (drains to Middle Yuba via Bloody Run)

properties.site: Moores Flat pit NW edge (Yeend 1974 fig 9 lower gravel locality)
properties.what_visible: Photographed by Yeend 1968; 50+ years of weathering since; check for fresh face on undercut wall
properties.access: Walk pit rim counterclockwise from main road access.

properties.site: Shenanigan Flat / Canyon Creek Trailhead (Site A entry)
properties.what_visible: Hwy 49 bridge over N Yuba immediately upstream of Indian Valley Outpost; gated gravel road behind
properties.access: Hwy 49 ~6 mi N of Camptonville; locked gate on NW side of bridge, walk gravel rd ~1 mi to Shenanigan Flat.

properties.site: Cherokee Creek mouth on North Yuba (Site A midpoint)
properties.what_visible: Footbridge over Cherokee Cr where Canyon Creek Trail meets N Yuba
properties.access: From Shenanigan Flat trailhead, walk Canyon Creek Trail ~2 mi to footbridge.

properties.site: Ramshorn Campground (Site B entry)
properties.what_visible: USFS campground, parking, river access at Hwy 49; Halls Ranch trailhead adjacent
properties.access: Hwy 49 ~5.5 mi S of Downieville.

properties.site: N Yuba below Halls Ranch climb (Site B midpoint)
properties.what_visible: River channel below the slope where Halls Ranch Trail begins climbing
properties.access: Walk river bed/bank ~1 mi W from Ramshorn at low water.
properties.note: Trail does NOT cross river - it begins river-side at Ramshorn and climbs ~1,400 ft up to ridge.

properties.site: Jersey Bridge, Downieville (Site C entry)
properties.what_visible: 1938 Hwy 49 bridge over Downie River at confluence with N Yuba
properties.access: Downieville town center; park on Main St.

properties.site: N Yuba ~1 mi WSW of Downieville (Site C midpoint)
properties.what_visible: River in confined bedrock cut; Hwy 49 on N bank
properties.access: Hwy 49 pullouts and bushwhack to river.
properties.note: 'Mountain House' as a current near-river feature here could not be confirmed - historic Mountain House sites are on Henness Pass Rd ridge above.

properties.site: Convict Flat Picnic Area (Site D entry)
properties.what_visible: USFS picnic area, parking, Hwy 49 pullout, river access
properties.access: Hwy 49 between Indian Valley Campground and Ramshorn.

properties.site: N Yuba bedrock chute at Convict Flat (Site D midpoint)
properties.what_visible: Bedrock-confined river chute adjacent to picnic area
properties.access: Drop directly from picnic area.

properties.site: Gates of the Antipodes locale (Site E entry - GNIS feature)
properties.what_visible: Henness Pass Rd corridor; derelict log cabin at trail head per Sierra Club; trail drops steeply to gorge
properties.access: Henness Pass Rd 4WD spur from Jackson Meadows area.

properties.site: Middle Yuba gorge floor below Gates (Site E midpoint)
properties.what_visible: Class V/VI bedrock slot; no road access
properties.access: Steep 1-1.5 mi down-climb from rim - serious commitment.

properties.site: Below Milton Dam tailrace (Site F entry)
properties.what_visible: Small Milton impoundment, dam structure, Milton-Bowman tunnel intake
properties.access: FS roads via Jackson Meadows / Henness Pass Rd; FERC P-2266 project area.
properties.note: Reach is dewatered to ~3 cfs since 1928 (Milton diverts to Bowman).

properties.site: Middle Yuba ~3 river mi below Milton (Site F midpoint)
properties.what_visible: Steep granitic/metavolcanic canyon, low summer flow exposing bedrock crevices
properties.access: Spur roads off Henness Pass Rd; 0.5-1 mi bushwhack descents.
properties.note: Reach overlaps upstream end of Gates of the Antipodes (Site E) once geometry is corrected.

properties.site: Pliocene Ridge end-of-road descent to Middle Yuba (Site G entry - approximate)
properties.what_visible: Spur road off Pliocene Ridge near Pike/Alleghany road system
properties.access: Multiple candidate spurs; reconnoiter via Tahoe NF motor-vehicle-use map.
properties.note: Original 'Lafayette Ridge / Mtn House / Pliocene Ridge end-of-road' conflated three different features. Re-research recommended for the specific drop-in point that actually reaches the Middle Yuba below Kanaka Cr.

properties.site: Middle Yuba below Kanaka Creek confluence (Site G midpoint)
properties.what_visible: River channel immediately below Kanaka Cr mouth in steep forested inner canyon
properties.access: 1,500+ ft bushwhack descent from Pliocene Ridge; serious off-trail effort.
properties.source: USGS gauge 11408850; USGS GNIS Kanaka Creek confluence

properties.site: Our House Diversion Dam (Site H entry)
properties.what_visible: 75-ft concrete diversion dam, Lohman Ridge Tunnel intake, FERC P-2246 infrastructure
properties.access: Our House Dam Rd off Ridge Rd from Hwy 49.
properties.note: Only ~1-2 mi of free-flowing river below the dam before Bullards Bar backwater begins.

properties.site: Oregon Creek Covered Bridge / Freemans Crossing (Site I entry)
properties.what_visible: 1860 Thomas Freeman covered bridge (NRHP #75000499), Tahoe NF Day Use Area, Middle Yuba confluence
properties.access: Hwy 49 at the Freemans Crossing concrete arch bridge.

properties.site: Oregon Creek inner gorge ~1.5 mi up from covered bridge (Site I midpoint)
properties.what_visible: Steep forested Oregon Creek canyon; reach below Log Cabin Dam (39.4393,-121.0591) is dewatered most of year
properties.access: Walk creek bed up from covered bridge; steep canyon sides.

properties.site: Third Divide Trail footbridge over Lavezzola Creek (Site J entry - estimated)
properties.what_visible: Footbridge in inner gorge under conifer canopy; small turnout above
properties.access: Lavezzola Rd from Downieville ~3.5 mi (0.7 mi past Second Divide road bridge).
properties.note: Approximate - footbridge precise location not field-verified.

properties.site: Lavezzola Creek inner gorge between bridges (Site J midpoint - estimated)
properties.what_visible: Granite gorge under canopy; wading required at low water
properties.access: Bushwhack downstream from footbridge.

properties.site: Second Divide trailhead on Lavezzola Rd (Site K entry - estimated)
properties.what_visible: Small dirt pullout, trail sign, limited parking
properties.access: Lavezzola Rd from Downieville ~2.7-3 mi.
properties.note: Trailhead is on Lavezzola Rd, but trail climbs to ridge between Lavezzola and Pauley drainages then drops to Pauley Cr.

properties.site: Pauley Creek above Federal Falls (Site K midpoint - estimated)
properties.what_visible: Cascade-and-plunge-pool granite gorge; 15-25 ft falls (Federal, Pauley) downstream of pin
properties.access: Second Divide trail ~1 mi to Y, right fork drops to creek with minor rock climbing.
properties.note: Original submission had K.midpoint on wrong creek (Lavezzola); this pin is estimated from cacreeks.com Pauley Cr run description.
